column5: One authenticated stock MySQL connection and retained Rust SQL-node process prove all six signed-BIGINT comparisons, reversed operands, conjunction, predicate-only scan input, empty result, observable TableScan-plus-Selection execution, A-to-B-to-C-to-restarted-B leadership, blocked-query cancellation, ordered shutdown, zero exit, and tag-owned cleanup against three real PD and TiKV nodes. The proof remains bounded to one configured nonpartitioned table and a failpoint-enabled Go TiDB fixture used only for setup and the lock barrier; the broader RealTiKV suite, dynamic catalog, writes, and general SQL semantics remain open.
